description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewDao class, responsible for data access operations related to performance reviews within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting performance reviews, as well as managing associated entities such as reviewers, reviewer ratings, and search filters. The class facilitates database interactions and encapsulates complex queries for performance review data management.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing performance review entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, search filtering, reviewer management, and related entity interactions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees supervised by a specific employee based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching the supervision filter criteria.

methods.name: createReview
methods.description: Creates a new performance review, persisting it to the database and linking it with reviewers.

methods.name: getReviewById
methods.description: Retrieves a performance review by its unique identifier if it exists.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewById
methods.description: Fetches a performance review entity by ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewList
methods.description: Returns a list of performance reviews filtered by specified criteria.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewCount
methods.description: Counts the total number of performance reviews matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceSelfReviewStatus
methods.description: Returns the review status as a string ('Activated', 'In Progress', 'Completed') for a given performance review.

methods.name: updateReview
methods.description: Updates an existing performance review, including reviewers, in a transactional manner.

methods.name: deletePerformanceReviewReviewers
methods.description: Deletes all reviewer associations for a specified performance review.

methods.name: getSupervisorRecord
methods.description: Retrieves supervisor-reporting relationships between employees based on subordinate and supervisor IDs.

methods.name: getReviewKPI
methods.description: Fetches KPIs associated with a specific performance review.

methods.name: getPerformanceSelfReviewer
methods.description: Gets the reviewer entity representing the employee's self-review for a specific performance review.

methods.name: deletePerformanceReviews
methods.description: Deletes multiple performance reviews based on a list of IDs.

methods.name: getReviewIdList
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of all active performance reviews (excluding those with a non-null employee purge date).

methods.name: getSelfReviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of performance reviews for a specific employee, optionally filtered by status.

methods.name: getReviewerRating
methods.description: Obtains reviewer ratings for a supervisor evaluation, filtered by review and reviewer group.

methods.name: getReviewerRatingCount
methods.description: Counts reviewer ratings for a supervisor evaluation based on filter criteria.

methods.name: getKpiIdsForReviewId
methods.description: Fetches KPI IDs associated with a particular review ID.

methods.name: getKpiIdsForJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves KPI IDs linked to a specific job title.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateReviewerRatings
methods.description: Persists new or updated reviewer ratings, efficiently updating existing ratings.

methods.name: getReviewerRecord
methods.description: Fetches a Reviewer entity for a given review ID and reviewer group name.

methods.name: updateReviewerStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of reviewers linked to a performance review within a specific group.

methods.name: updateReviewerComment
methods.description: Updates the comment left by a reviewer for a specific performance review.
